description: NaNbO₃ is (Cubic) Perovskite structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic P222₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.93 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.79-2.88 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.72-2.96 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight NbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-2.95 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with eight NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-8°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.13 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra and faces with eight NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-12°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.11 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four Na and two Nb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Nb atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₄Nb₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-61°.
